steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: Th-The guns have stopped.

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: C-Can we go now? Not upwards, but down, before the bombs reach us—

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: Get up, Yuri, and the rest of you. We need to find Rankin and the place he was talking about.

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: You know the bravest ones of us have all left with Rankin, to take the outpost.

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: The bombing's stopped, and we don't know what's going on up there. The only way to find them is up.

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: Either we save them, or, as Rankin said, remember them. Crawl, pull yourselves on with your pickaxes, if you can't walk.

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: But Rankin gave us his mining lamp—

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: Do you remember what he said?

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: He... he didn't say anything...

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: That's right. He didn't say anything. This is no different from the supplies that they left behind.

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: Or we can choose to leave it here... as a reminder.

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: Yes, reminder. Leave the lamp in the mining cart, the one that we pushed all the way here.

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: If anyone ever comes through...

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: I remember that you can write, Yuri.

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: We've got some blank pages at the back of the logbook. We might as well not waste it.

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: Come here. I'll tell you what to write.

steps.name: Worried Miner
steps.text: If anyone comes, at least they'll know what happened here.

steps.name: Sick Miner
steps.text: Sir, where... where are we going?

steps.name: Sick Miner
steps.text: I don't think the factory's this way—

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Shut up and keep walking.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: I said walk!

steps.name: Skeptical Miner
steps.text: (Whisper) The mines have stopped again.

steps.name: Skeptical Miner
steps.text: (Whisper) So, nothing for the processing plants to work with.

steps.name: Skeptical Miner
steps.text: (Whisper) Where would they take us, if they don't need hands upstairs?

steps.name: Fearful Miner
steps.text: They dragged even the sickest ones out of their beds. Half the mine is here...

steps.name: Fearful Miner
steps.text: I don't want to keep walking. I don't want to die!

steps.name: Skeptical Miner
steps.text: (Whisper) Shh!

steps.name: Army Officer
steps.text: Go through the forest, to the lake. That's where you'll meet your end.

steps.name: Army Officer
steps.text: Don't even think...

steps.name: Army Officer
steps.text: About running away.
Heavy military boots step on the snowy forest floor, moving forward, urging forward.
The miners are being escorted by far more than just a few men.

steps.name: Army Officer
steps.text: Here. Stop.

steps.name: Army Officer
steps.text: Let's begin.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Everyone, on the ice.

steps.name: Fearful Miner
steps.text: No, sir, please—
The saber cuts her throat, spilling hot blood on the soldier's armor.

steps.name: Army Officer
steps.text: For the glory of Ursus.

steps.name: Sick Miner
steps.text: Bozhe moy...

steps.name: Army Officer
steps.text: Proceed.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: N-Next! Fill the gap! Hurry!

steps.name: Skeptical Miner
steps.text: Why do we have to be treated like this?

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Shut up, you uyobok—

steps.name: Skeptical Miner
steps.text: Were the Tsar's promises all a lie? Are our lives worth less than that of a burdenbeast?

steps.name: Skeptical Miner
steps.text: Tell me—
As the soldier is about to raise his hand again, the rumbling of the ground becomes perceptible.
It starts with a tiny crack, from the surface, from deep below, before snowballing quickly.
The ground trembles, and the center of the lake collapses. The result of geological changes accumulated over time swallows the Infected on the ice, and their would-be executioners.

steps.name: Skeptical Miner
steps.text: Run!
The miner shakes off the stunned soldier and runs in the direction they came from.

steps.name: Terrified Miner
steps.text: Catastrophe...

steps.name: Terrified Miner
steps.text: It's a Catastrophe!!!
Soldier, miner. Killer, victim. The vast Lake Angara accepts all and delivers all.
Beneath the ice, an ancient nomadic city rises as the terrain changes, emerging through the sheet into the light of day.
The old-style buildings and the writhing faces of the dead look the same as they did when the city sank.

steps.name: Diligent Miner
steps.text: 'Northern Tundra'... 'Catastrophe'... 'Lake'...

steps.name: Diligent Miner
steps.text: All those words crammed into this tiny space, and I only recognize three.

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: You'll learn them in time.

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: The lessons here are too basic for me. I'm planning to take over the work at the mines, which has been left untended for a while, and maybe learn a craft other than shoe repair.

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: Once the curfew is lifted, I want to go to Deity Grypherburg.

steps.name: Diligent Miner
steps.text: I don't want to go to Grypherburg. I just want to learn to read. Three words a day makes twenty-one a week. In one month...

steps.name: Koshelna
steps.text: I'm glad to see your eagerness.

steps.name: Koshelna
steps.text: Do you need help?

steps.name: Diligent Miner
steps.text: These words still confuse me, gospozha.

steps.name: Koshelna
steps.text: You're talking about these 'nouns', right? That's the lesson for this week—we're learning about nouns.

steps.name: Diligent Miner
steps.text: Nouns, yes! Nouns. I think I'm starting to be able to tell them apart, but I can't quite get their meanings.

steps.name: Diligent Miner
steps.text: What's this... uh... 'Shimok'?

steps.name: Koshelna
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Koshelna
steps.text: It's 'Simonch'. It's a name, like the name 'Angara', the lake, or your name, 'Vova'.

steps.name: Koshelna
steps.text: It's the name of a nomadic city.
The youth bids his classmate farewell and goes into the mines, ready to get to work.
Mine tunnels left untended gradually wear down and eventually collapse. He will not allow it to happen, as long as he is still here.
The young man raises his mining lamp and begins his rounds, examining all the rail, until he finds a mining cart at one of the forks that does not belong to this place.

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: A mining lamp?

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: And a letter—

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: This was once the place of a struggle?

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: Damn it. The people who proposed connecting the mining districts were here! They wanted to occupy that garrisoned outpost!

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: I knew the story was true...

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: Whoever's lamp this was, it's in good condition. Maybe a little dusty, but it still works...

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: Maybe I should take it to Grypherburg—

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: And show everyone...

steps.name: Young Craftsman
steps.text: This lamp without a name, and those people without names.
